# The Eden Institute

> Publisher of Eden's Table, a Christian K-5 homeschool science and nature study curriculum, and of adult courses in Biblical herbalism. The Eden Institute teaches constitutional (Biblical) herbalism, the practice of matching herbs to a person's unique body pattern rather than to isolated symptoms, grounded in Scripture and clinical rigor. We also publish Eden's Table, a Christ-centered homeschool herbalism curriculum: Sprouts (K-2) and Seedlings (grades 3-5) are on sale now, with grades 6-12 planned.

## Core concepts
- [What Is Constitutional Herbalism?](https://edeninstitute.health/constitutional-herbalism): Constitutional (Biblical) herbalism matches herbs to the person, not the symptom. Covers the six tissue states (hot, cold, damp, dry, tense, relaxed), the Five Tenets of Health (Hydration, Movement, Nutrition, Rest, Connection), and the Scriptural basis for terrain-based plant medicine.
- [Why Eden](https://edeninstitute.health/why-eden): The worldview, philosophy, and founding conviction behind the Institute: a Western, biblically anchored alternative to Eastern and New Age frameworks.

## Programs
- [Eden's Table: Homeschool Herbalism Curriculum](https://edeninstitute.health/homeschool): A Christ-centered homeschool curriculum teaching Biblical herbalism and the body God designed, with open-and-go weekly lessons. Two grade bands are on sale: Sprouts (K-2) and Seedlings (grades 3-5), which teach different sets of 36 plants. Week 1 of each is free. Cultivators (grades 6-8) and Practitioners (grades 9-12) are planned.
- [Sprouts Printed Curriculum Set](https://edeninstitute.health/books#buy): All 36 weeks of Sprouts (K-2) in three printed books (Teacher's Guide, Student Notebook, Read-Aloud Storybook), $249 plus $12 shipping, printed to order and shipped in about two to three weeks. Extra Student Notebooks for siblings, $39.99 each, can be added at checkout.
- [Seedlings Printed Curriculum Set](https://edeninstitute.health/books#seedlings): All 36 weeks of Seedlings (grades 3-5) in three printed books (Teacher's Guide, Student Notebook, Read-Aloud Storybook), $249 plus $12 shipping, printed to order and shipped in about two to three weeks. Extra Student Notebooks for siblings, $39.99 each, can be added at checkout.
- [Sprouts 9-Week Starter Unit](https://edeninstitute.health/starter): Weeks 1 to 9 of Sprouts as an instant digital download, $39.
- [Seedlings 9-Week Starter Unit](https://edeninstitute.health/starter/seedlings): Weeks 1 to 9 of Seedlings as an instant digital download, $39.
- [Courses](https://edeninstitute.health/courses): The Eden Institute's three-tier clinical herbalism education program: Foundations, Body Systems & Clinical Literacy, and Clinical Application & Mentorship.
- [Free Body Pattern Assessment](https://edeninstitute.health/assessment): A short quiz that identifies your constitutional body pattern across the six tissue states.

## Scholarship and ESA families
- [Use your ESA or scholarship for Eden's Table](https://edeninstitute.health/esa): Eden's Table (Sprouts, grades K-2, and Seedlings, grades 3-5, Bible-based science and nature study) is an approved or registered vendor in seven education savings account and scholarship programs: Arizona ESA, Utah Fits All, Louisiana GATOR, Wyoming ESA, Arkansas EFA, Alabama CHOOSE Act and New Hampshire EFA. Each state page explains how buying works in that program right now, including where a marketplace listing is still pending.
- [Arizona ESA](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/arizona) · [Utah Fits All](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/utah) · [Louisiana GATOR](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/louisiana) · [Wyoming ESA](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/wyoming) · [Arkansas EFA](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/arkansas) · [Alabama CHOOSE Act](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/alabama) · [New Hampshire EFA](https://edeninstitute.health/esa/new-hampshire)
- [Curriculum specifications](https://edeninstitute.health/curriculum): Product specifications for scholarship programs and families: printed set (Sprouts or Seedlings) $261 total ($249 plus $12 shipping), 9-week starter (Sprouts or Seedlings) $39, extra student notebook (Sprouts or Seedlings) $39.99. Where a program's payment platform charges a vendor processing fee, the invoice shows it as its own line: in Arizona the set is $266.33 and an extra notebook $40.81. Arkansas, Alabama and New Hampshire invoices have no fee.

## Podcast
- [Tales & Table Talk](https://edeninstitute.health/tales-and-table-talk): A weekly read-aloud podcast for moms and their littles. Every episode is a story, and every episode ends at the table. Launching January on the Ultimate Homeschool Podcast Network.

## Community
- [The Rooted Community](https://edeninstitute.health/community): A private network for homesteaders, homeschool families, and liberty-minded believers building lives connected to the land, the body, and each other.
